charter.need: Select the auxiliary power source for the vehicle concept: at least 8 hours of silent watch at 3.5 kW and 49 C ambient, with the lowest field-maintenance burden at acceptable cost and mass.
charter.gate: Before the concept gate every option needs a completed thermal qualification run and a reliability review of its current technical data.

thermal.A1: RUN_THERMAL_SWEEP_0007 (thermal model v4.2, sealed; 3.5 kW load, 49 C ambient, 8 h required): complete. 10.0 h of silent watch, 6 C margin. Pass.
thermal.A2: RUN_THERMAL_SWEEP_0007 (thermal model v4.2, sealed; 3.5 kW load, 49 C ambient, 8 h required): complete. 8.1 h of silent watch, 3 C margin. Pass.
thermal.A3: RUN_THERMAL_SWEEP_0007 (thermal model v4.2, sealed; 3.5 kW load, 49 C ambient, 8 h required): complete. 24.0 h of silent watch, 9 C margin. Pass.

techdata.basis: supplier qualification data, consistent with RUN_THERMAL_SWEEP_0007
